name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Top-level integration module that exposes the MMIO/CSR window, request/response streams, sequencing, validation, timeout, and actuator gating. The top module owns all externally visible outputs and implements the complete control/supervision behavior required by the product contract.
functionality: Integrates register decode, control FSM, request/response transport, validation, timeout detection, and command clamping. Maintains a monotonically increasing sequence number and only asserts actuator_valid when a response is accepted as fresh and valid. All fault handling is deterministic and software-visible through fault_flags and MMIO status; no physics model is embedded.
responsibilities: Own all top-level outputs and drive them from real RTL logic.
Decode MMIO transactions into configuration and status access.
Generate bounded request packets for the external surrogate service.
Validate inbound response packets and freshness.
Implement fault latching and MMIO status reporting.
Clamp actuator output to configured limits when valid command data is available.
Inhibit actuator_valid on reset or any fault condition.
reset_behavior: All state is synchronously reset by reset_n: registers clear to defaults, faults clear, outstanding transaction state clears, request/response handshakes are idle, actuator_valid is low, fault_flags are low, and actuator_cmd returns to a deterministic non-authoritative reset value. The module does not assert a valid actuator command until a response has been validated.
behavior_rules: The top module is the sole design top and must not be substituted by a child module.
Every top-level output must be driven by internal RTL logic, not left unconnected.
MMIO access is synchronous and write-then-read consistent within the selected register map.
Request generation must only occur when enabled/armed and there is no pending outstanding request.
Outbound request data must include opcode, sequence number, geometry reference ID, velocity setpoint, mode bits, and reserved fields within 96 bits.
Response acceptance requires matching sequence number and completion status; malformed responses are rejected.
On reject, timeout, or stale response, fault_flags bits are asserted and remain latched until clear.
The actuator output is not a fallback substitute on fault; instead actuator_valid is deasserted while the fault is latched for software handling.
The module must remain synthesizable with synchronous state elements and combinational next-state logic only.
No Sky130 hard macro may be instantiated.
The MMIO register contract described in register_contract is authoritative and all registers must be reachable through decode.
